scope: Eight exact PNGs: seven native previews and HB/SNL comparison. Qualitative arrangement review with independent panel scales.
findings: Installed and isolated isometrics show the new cone-support collar around SH999A, with the front snap ring and bearing visible in the open bore. The former external spring and wired collar joint remain attached.

The axial section now contains a long bronze-colored bearing, rear sleeve overlap, rounded middle relief and front retaining ring. This follows the catalogue nesting; the old empty section is preserved beside it.

Four keys are seated in receiving beds and the outer support has matching grooves. Only two keys are visible in the chosen exterior isometric; source quantities and all four actual solids are checked independently.

The isolated sleeve exposes24straight internal spline grooves, a cylindrical barrel and rear flange. Its bearing overlap is apparent in section, while the exterior internals view mostly hides the sleeve behind the bearing.
The retention section shows the separate snap-ring ridge captured inside the collar groove and the ring bearing against the front bearing face. The isometric shows the inferred split.

No obvious unintended collisions, duplicated envelope pieces or disconnected ring were seen. The crankshaft space remains empty and the main cones, thrust mechanism and small spring sets are visibly absent.
remaining_discrepancies: The key bands appear thicker than the catalogue drawing. Literal HB .75in radial thickness and .375in tangential width are provisional transfers with unresolved section-axis interpretation.
SNL bearingSH998D, sleeveSH861B and ringSH861E differ from HB SH863A,SH864C andSH863C. Native OD152mm is estimated for the catalogue bearing profile; HB4.684in OD is not applied.
Axial stations, stepped bores, relief blends, support contours and snap-ring ridge/split are inferred. Independent panel scales cannot establish dimensional agreement.
Smooth sleeve-to-collar fitting does not establish the actual drive attachment or torque transmission. Crankshaft spline engagement, cone/rivet attachments and bearing-load fit remain unfinished.
